_comment: Copy to %USERPROFILE%\.pennylane\tokens.json and paste one token per company. One file per person. Never commit it, never put it on a shared drive.
_doc: Company API token: Pennylane > Settings > Connectivity > Developers > Generate an API Token. A token is bound to ONE company, so a group needs one per entity.

company-a.label: Company A Ltd
company-a._scopes_needed: supplier_invoices:all, suppliers:all, file_attachments:all, transactions:all, customer_invoices:all, ledger_entries:all, exports:fec

no-api-entity.label: Small entity without API access
no-api-entity.note: Plan does not include API access. PLHdr throws an explicit error for this slug on purpose: handle it manually and say so in the report rather than failing mid-batch.
